[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Before and after preparing food  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - After blowing your nose, coughing, or sneezing

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained how to wash hands properly:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Wet hands with warm water  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Apply enough soap to cover hands  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Rub hands together to create a lather, ensuring soap gets in between fingers, under nails, and on the backs of hands  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Rub hands for at least 20 seconds, suggesting to sing the "Happy Birthday" song twice to time it  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant instructed to rinse hands thoroughly under running water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised to dry hands completely with a clean towel or air dryer.
